DFM & Tolerance Summary (Verified by automated SDF tests):
• Build volume: Ø120 × 146.6 mm (well inside K1C 220 × 220 × 250 mm)
• Zero supports required: lid & motor_deck exported upside-down; 45° duct
• Non-contact labyrinth: 0.60 mm radial & 0.60 mm vertical air gaps
• Min PETG wall ≥ 2.2 mm · Includes calibration_coupon.stl fit-check
